crossRefs.note: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t…
Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering…
Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
Send Zenas, the lawyer, and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

translations.web: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
translations.bsb: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:
translations.kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
translations.asv: And one of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, trying him:
